name: Numeric Drift (2x Forward)
description: LLM claims 10 seconds timeout when fact shows 5000ms (5 seconds) - 2x difference triggers fallback
draftText: API_TIMEOUT is configured to 10 seconds to allow for slow network conditions.
notes: Text says 10s but fact is 3000ms (3s). After conversion: 3s vs 10s = 3.33x ratio ≥ 2.0 → fallback per CTS-02 §4.2.
